name: Settlement and Artificial Mummification of the Chinchorro Culture in the Arica and Parinacota Region
description: On the arid Pacific coast of northern Chile, in and around the city of Arica, the Chinchorro fishing people created the oldest known deliberately preserved human bodies, thousands of years before the Egyptian mummies. They took apart the dead, rebuilt them with clay, wigs and mineral pigments, and did this for men, women and children alike. Three sites, including one about 100 km south, hold their cemeteries.
